scope: Docker PG capped at 2 CPU/1GiB; host Node worker uncapped. Fast workflow suite used another database on the same PG cluster. Not a whole-machine 2CPU/4GiB acceptance.
metricNotes: Docker CPU 100% represents one core. ps CPU is lifetime average, not instantaneous.

journalRelationFootprintSumBytes sums all schema relations and double-counts indexes; retained as a trend metric only. finalStorage.journalTableBytes filters regular/materialized tables and counts their indexes once.
hostWorkflowWorkers matches fixture process names; summary isolates verified long-worker PID29691 rather than attributing every matching process to this run.
WAL is cluster-wide and includes fast suite/migrations; growth excludes time before first sample.
